## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates multi-region deployment strategies, tenant-aware traffic routing, and production-grade safety controls for an intermediate DevOps engineer role.

## Key Concepts
- Blue/Green deployments across Azure regions
- Azure Front Door per-tenant routing
- Progressive canary rollout by tenant
- Gate enforcement with Azure Policy + OPA
- Drift detection against ARM templates
- Automatic rollback to blue on failure
- Comprehensive logging to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  blueRegion: 'eastus'
  greenRegion: 'westus2'
  canaryPercentage: 1

stages:
  - stage: PreDeploy_Validation
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyGate
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
          - task: Bash@3
            name: 'OPAValidation'
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                opa eval --input tenant-config.json --format json --fail-defined-fail data.policies.deny data.policies.warn

  - stage: DeployBlue
    dependsOn: PreDeploy_Validation
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToBlueRegion
        environment: 'blue-$(blueRegion)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)-blue'
                    templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
                    csmFile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/templates/api-blue.json'
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  name: 'RunSmokeTests'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az functionapp test run --name api-blue --test-type smoke
                      
  - stage: DeployGreen
    dependsOn: DeployBlue
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToGreenRegion
        environment: 'green-$(greenRegion)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)-green'
                    templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
                    csmFile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/templates/api-green.json'
                
  - stage: CanaryRollout
    dependsOn: DeployGreen
    variables:
      tenantList: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/tenants/tenant-list.json'
    jobs:
      - job: PromoteCanary
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'RouteCanaryTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANTS=$(jq -r '.tenants | length * 0.01 | floor' $(tenantList))
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name canary-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --route-type Performance \
                  --pattern '/*'
                  --backend-pool-name canary-pool
                  
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            name: 'CheckCanaryMetrics'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              ResourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              alertRules:
                - alertName: 'CanaryErrorRate'
                  condition: 'avg(errorRate) > 5'
                  action: 'fail'
          
  - stage: ProductionPromotion
    dependsOn: CanaryRollout
    condition: succeeded('CanaryRollout')
    jobs:
      - job: UpdateFrontDoorRouting
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'SwitchTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name production-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --backend-pool-name green-pool
                  
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'DriftCheck'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group compare \
                  --resource-group $(rgName)-green \
                  --template-file templates/api-green.json
                  
  - stage: Rollback
    dependsOn: ProductionPromotion
    condition: failed()
    jobs:
      - job: RollbackToBlue
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'RevertTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name production-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --backend-pool-name blue-pool
                  
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'NotifyFailure'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor alert create \
                  --name pipeline-failure \
                  --resource-group $(rgName) \
                  --description 'Blue/Green deployment failed - rolled back to blue'
```

**Pipeline Flow Summary**

1. **Pre-Deploy Validation** - Azure Policy gate and OPA policy validation before any deployment
2. **Deploy Blue** - Deploy to blue region with smoke tests
3. **Deploy Green** - Deploy to green region for canary testing
4. **Canary Rollout** - Route 1% of tenants to green, monitor metrics
5. **Production Promotion** - Switch Front Door to green, run drift detection
6. **Automatic Rollback** - On failure, revert Front Door to blue and notify

  - main
pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: BuildAndTest
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm ci
            displayName: 'Install dependencies'
          - script: npm test
            displayName: 'Run unit tests'
          - script: npm run lint
            displayName: 'Run ESLint'
          - task: Docker@2
            inputs:
              command: buildAndPush
              repository: '$(ACR_LOGIN_SERVER)/app:$(Build.BuildId)'
              dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'
              containerRegistry: '$(ACR_SERVICE_CONNECTION)'

  - stage: Deploy
    dependsOn: Build
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'))
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToAKS
        environment: 'aks-pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION)'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      PR_ID=$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)
                      NAMESPACE="pr-$PR_ID"
                      kubectl create namespace $NAMESPACE --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
                      kubectl set image deployment/app app=$(ACR_LOGIN_SERVER)/app:$(Build.BuildId) -n $NAMESPACE
                      kubectl expose deployment/app --type=LoadBalancer --port=80 --target-port=3000 -n $NAMESPACE

                      SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc app -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].ip}')

                - task: AzureMonitor@1
                  inputs:
                    alertResourceGroup: '$(RESOURCE_GROUP)'
                    metricsResourceID: '$(AZURE_MONITOR_RESOURCE_ID)'

## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates the ability to implement a secure, tenant-aware secret rotation workflow in a CI/CD pipeline, integrating Azure Key Vault, App Configuration, and multi-tenant deployments with automated rollback and centralized monitoring.

## Key Concepts

- Cloud key management and rotation scheduling
- Multi-tenant deployment strategies with per-tenant feature flags
- Drift detection against repository, ARM templates, or desired state
- Canary and rollback semantics across environments
- Centralized observability via Azure Monitor Logs

## Code Example

```yaml
trigger: none

parameters:
  - name: tenants
    type: object
    default:
      - tenantId: 'tenant-1'
        appConfigName: 'app-config-1'
      - tenantId: 'tenant-2'
        appConfigName: 'app-config-2'
  - name: keyVaultName
    type: string
    default: 'kv-signing-keys'
  - name: rotationIntervalDays
    type: number
    default: 30

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  resourceGroupName: 'rg-multitenant-api'
  appServicePlan: 'asp-multitenant'
  stagingSlot: 'staging'

stages:
  - stage: Secret_Rotation
    displayName: 'Rotate Signing Keys'
    jobs:
      - job: Check_Rotation_Due
        displayName: 'Check if Rotation is Due'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Check Last Rotation Date'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                lastRotation=$(az keyvault secret show \
                  --vault-name ${{ parameters.keyVaultName }} \
                  --name signing-key-version \
                  --query 'attributes.updated'
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=lastRotation;isOutput=true]"$lastRotation

          - task: PythonScript@1
            displayName: 'Determine if Rotation Required'
            inputs:
              script: |
                import os
                from datetime import datetime, timedelta
                last_rotation = "${{ variables.lastRotation }}"
                days_since_rotation = (datetime.now() - datetime.fromisoformat(last_rotation)).days
                should_rotate = days_since_rotation >= ${{ parameters.rotationIntervalDays }}
                print(f"Days since rotation: {days_since_rotation}")
                print(f"Rotation required: {should_rotate}")
                os.environ['SHOULD_ROTATE'] = str(should_rotate)

      - job: Rotate_Keys
        displayName: 'Rotate Signing Keys'
        dependsOn: Check_Rotation_Due
        condition: eq(dependencies.Check_Rotation_Due.outputs['check.shouldRotate'], true)
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Generate New Signing Key'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                newKey=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
                az keyvault secret set \
                  --vault-name ${{ parameters.keyVaultName }} \
                  --name signing-key-current \
                  --value "$newKey" \
                  --tags rotation-date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insets telemetry create \
                  --app "secret-rotation-pipeline" \
                  --custom-properties "{\"event\": \"key-rotated\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ)\"}"

  - stage: Build
    displayName: 'Build Application'
    jobs:
      - job: Build_And_Package
        displayName: 'Build and Package'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: 'Install .NET SDK'
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.x'

          - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
            displayName: 'Restore Dependencies'
            inputs:
              command: 'restore'
              projects: '**/*.csproj'

          - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
            displayName: 'Build Application'
            inputs:
              command: 'build'
              projects: '**/*.csproj'
              arguments: '--configuration Release'

          - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
            inputs:
              command: 'test'
              projects: '**/*Tests.csproj'
              arguments: '--configuration Release --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"'

          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            displayName: 'Publish Build Artifact'
            inputs:
              targetPath: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)'
              artifact: 'drop'

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    displayName: 'Deploy to Staging'
    jobs:
      - job: Deploy_To_Staging
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - download: current
            artifact: 'drop'

          - ${{ each tenant in parameters.tenants }}:
            - task: AzureCLI@2
              displayName: 'Deploy to Staging - Tenant ${{ tenant.tenantId }}'
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                scriptType: 'bash'
                scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                inlineScript: |
                  az webapp deployment slot create \
                    --name "api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}" \
                    --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                    --slot $(stagingSlot)

                  az webapp deployment source config-local-git \
                    --name "api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}" \
                    --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                    --slot $(stagingSlot)

          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: 'Update Feature Flags - Staging'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://${{ tenant.appConfigName }}.azconfig.io'
              JsonContent: |
                {
                  "features": {
                    "newSigningKey": {
                      "enabledFor": [
                        "Staging"
                      ]
                    }
                  }
                }

  - stage: E2E_Tests
    displayName: 'End-to-End Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Run_E2E_Tests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run E2E Tests for All Tenants'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                failedTenants=""
                ${{ each tenant in parameters.tenants }}:
                  echo "Testing tenant ${{ tenant.tenantId }}"
                  result=$(az functionapp test \
                    --name "api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}-$(stagingSlot)" \
                    --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                    --testUrl "https://api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}.azurewebsites.net/health" \
                    --connect-timeout 30 \
                    --response-timeout 60)
                  
                  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
                    failedTenants="$failedTenants ${{ tenant.tenantId }}"
                  fi

                if [ -n "$failedTenants" ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=failedTenants]$failedTenants"
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]E2E tests failed for tenants:$failedTenants"
                  exit 1
                fi

  - stage: Drift_Detection
    displayName: 'Repository Drift Check'
    dependsOn: E2E_Tests
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: Check_For_Drift
        displayName: 'Detect Configuration Drift'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self
            persistCredentials: true

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Check ARM Template Drift'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group what-if \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                  --template-file ./infra/main.bicep \
                  --parameters ./infra/parameters.json \
                  --result-format FullResourcePayloads > drift-report.txt

                if [ -s drift-report.txt ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Drift detected in ARM templates"
                  echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=driftDetected]true"
                fi

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Check Key Vault Policy Drift'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                expectedPolicy=$(cat ./infra/keyvault-policy.json)
                currentPolicy=$(az keyvault show \
                  --name ${{ parameters.keyVaultName }} \
                  --query 'properties.accessPolicies')

                if [ "$expectedPolicy" != "$currentPolicy" ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Key Vault policy drift detected"
                  echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=driftDetected]true"
                fi

  - stage: Deploy_Production
    displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
    dependsOn:
      - E2E_Tests
      - Drift_Detection
    condition: |
      and(
        succeeded(),
        eq(dependencies.E2E_Tests.outputs['tests.failedTenants'], ''),
        eq(dependencies.Drift_Detection.outputs['check.driftDetected'], 'false')
      )
    jobs:
      - job: Deploy_To_Production
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - download: current
            artifact: 'drop'

          - ${{ each tenant in parameters.tenants }}:
            - task: AzureCLI@2
              displayName: 'Deploy to Production - Tenant ${{ tenant.tenantId }}'
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                scriptType: 'bash'
                scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                inlineScript: |
                  az webapp deployment slot swap \
                    --name "api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}" \
                    --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                    --slot $(stagingSlot) \
                    --target-slot production

          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: 'Enable Feature Flags - Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://${{ tenant.appConfigName }}.azconfig.io'
              JsonContent: |
                {
                  "features": {
                    "newSigningKey": {
                      "enabledFor": [
                        "Production"
                      ]
                    }
                  }
                }

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Deployment to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insets telemetry create \
                  --app "deployment-pipeline" \
                  --custom-properties "{\"event\": \"deployed-to-production\", \"tenant\": \"${{ tenant.tenantId }}\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ)\"}"

  - stage: Rollback
    displayName: 'Rollback (on Failure)'
    dependsOn:
      - E2E_Tests
      - Drift_Detection
    condition: |
      or(
        failed(),
        and(
          eq(dependencies.E2E_Tests.outputs['tests.failedTenants'], ''),
          eq(dependencies.Drift_Detection.outputs['check.driftDetected'], 'true')
        )
      )
    jobs:
      - job: Rollback_Keys
        displayName: 'Rollback Signing Keys'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Restore Previous Signing Key'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                previousKey=$(az keyvault secret show \
                  --vault-name ${{ parameters.keyVaultName }} \
                  --name signing-key-previous \
                  --query 'value'

                az keyvault secret set \
                  --vault-name ${{ parameters.keyVaultName }} \
                  --name signing-key-current \
                  --value "$previousKey" \
                  --tags rollback-date=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Rollback to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insets telemetry create \
                  --app "rollback-pipeline" \
                  --custom-properties "{\"event\": \"keys-rolled-back\", \"reason\": \"${{ variables.rollbackReason }}\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ)\"}"

      - job: Rollback_Code
        displayName: 'Rollback Code Deployment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - ${{ each tenant in parameters.tenants }}:
            - task: AzureCLI@2
              displayName: 'Rollback Production - Tenant ${{ tenant.tenantId }}'
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                scriptType: 'bash'
                scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                inlineScript: |
                  az webapp deployment slot swap \
                    --name "api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}" \
                    --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                    --slot $(stagingSlot) \
                    --target-slot production

                  az webapp deployment slot delete \
                    --name "api-${{ tenant.tenantId }}" \
                    --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) \
                    --slot $(stagingSlot)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Code Rollback to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insets telemetry create \
                  --app "rollback-pipeline" \
                  --custom-properties "{\"event\": \"code-rolled-back\", \"tenant\": \"${{ tenant.tenantId }}\", \"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ)\"}"

  - stage: Notify
    displayName: 'Send Notifications'
    dependsOn:
      - Deploy_Production
      - Rollback
    condition: always()
    jobs:
      - job: Send_Notifications
        displayName: 'Notify Stakeholders'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Query Azure Monitor for Pipeline Logs'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights query \
                  --app "secret-rotation-pipeline" \
                  --analytics-query "traces | where timestamp > ago(1d) | order by timestamp desc" \
                  --export-to-json true > pipeline-logs.json

          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            displayName: 'Publish Pipeline Logs'
            inputs:
              targetPath: 'pipeline-logs.json'
              artifact: 'pipeline-logs'
```

## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates the ability to design end-to-end tenant onboarding pipelines with Infrastructure as Code, multi-tenant isolation, and governance controls.

## Key Concepts

- Terraform remote backend per tenant with state locking
- AKS namespace isolation with per-tenant RBAC
- Per-tenant App Configuration, Key Vault, and Storage provisioning
- VNet provisioning with cross-tenant peering
- Drift detection with automatic rollback capabilities
- Observability and auditing via Azure Monitor

## Code Example

```yaml
trigger:
- main

parameters:
- name: tenantId
  type: string
  displayName: 'Tenant ID'

variables:
  terraformVersion: '1.5.0'
  acrName: 'acr$(environment)'
  aksCluster: 'aks-$(environment)'

stages:
  - stage: Prepare
    displayName: 'Validate Tenant Configuration'
    jobs:
      - job: Validate
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'spn-terraform'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az account show --id ${{ parameters.tenantId }}
                echo "Tenant validated"

  - stage: Plan
    displayName: 'Terraform Plan'
    dependsOn: Prepare
    jobs:
      - job: Plan
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: TerraformInstaller@1
            inputs:
              terraformVersion: $(terraformVersion)
          - task: TerraformTaskV4@4
            inputs:
              provider: 'azurerm'
              command: 'plan'
              environmentServiceName: 'spn-terraform'
              backendServiceArm: 'spn-terraform'
              backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: 'rg-terraform-state'
              backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: 'stterraformstate'
              backendAzureRmContainerName: 'tfstate'
              commandOptions: '-var tenant_id=${{ parameters.tenantId }} -out tfplan'
          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            inputs:
              targetPath: 'tfplan'
              artifact: 'tfplan'

  - stage: Approve
    displayName: 'Approval Gate'
    dependsOn: Plan
    jobs:
      - job: WaitForApproval
        pool: server
        timeoutInMinutes: 4320
        steps:
          - task: ManualValidation@0
            timeoutInMinutes: 4320
            inputs:
              instructions: 'Review Terraform plan and approve tenant provisioning'
              emailRecipients: '$(requestedFor)'

  - stage: Apply
    displayName: 'Terraform Apply'
    dependsOn: Approve
    jobs:
      - job: Apply
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
            inputs:
              artifact: 'tfplan'
          - task: TerraformTaskV4@4
            inputs:
              provider: 'azurerm'
              command: 'apply'
              environmentServiceName: 'spn-terraform'
              commandOptions: 'tfplan'

  - stage: Configure
    displayName: 'Configure Resources'
    dependsOn: Apply
    jobs:
      - job: ConfigureResources
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'spn-tenant'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Create AKS namespace
                az aks get-credentials --resource-group rg-aks --name $(aksCluster) --overwrite-existing
                kubectl create namespace ${{ parameters.tenantId }}
                
                # Configure Key Vault
                az keyvault set-policy --name kv-${{ parameters.tenantId }} --object-id ${{ parameters.tenantId }} --secret-permissions get list set delete

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy Application'
    dependsOn: Configure
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployApp
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        environment: 'aks-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: HelmDeploy@0
                  inputs:
                    connectionType: 'Azure Resource Manager'
                    azureSubscription: 'spn-tenant'
                    azureResourceGroup: 'rg-aks'
                    kubernetesCluster: 'aks-$(environment)'
                    namespace: ${{ parameters.tenantId }}
                    chartPath: 'chart'
                    releaseName: 'tenant-app'

  - stage: DriftCheck
    displayName: 'Drift Detection'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: CheckDrift
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'spn-tenant'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Check for configuration drift
                echo "Checking drift..."
                
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'spn-monitoring'
              alertRules:
                - alertName: 'TenantDriftDetected'
                  metricTrigger:
                    operator: 'GreaterThan'
                    threshold: 0

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: infrastructure
      type: git
      name: 'IaC/terraform-modules'
```
